hypothesis: Can the same DeBERTa judge recover grounded claims when the exact quote is surrounded by the largest source-message window that fits its context limit?

comparison.control: the already recorded exact quote only decision
comparison.treatment: a deterministic token window from the same source message, centered around and guaranteed to contain the exact quote

known_boundary: Five Q07 cases contain Russian evidence while the frozen DeBERTa model is English. They are reported separately and cannot pass or fail the English gate. The opened labels make this a diagnostic that must be replicated on fresh locked cases before production use.
